description: CRIT-201's passThreshold requires that 'a single control-flow read of spawn-orchestrator.mjs confirms a single call-graph root reaching every one of REQ-201/202/203/204/205/206/301/302/303/304/305/306's own exported functions/scripts', and 'FAIL if any EFFECTFUL step fires out of order or is skipped/duplicated'. REQ-204's own EARS Edge Cases text (behavioral-spec.md line ~1852) makes gas-seeding a hard SHALL, not an optional edge case: 'register() reverts for insufficient gas (the child's fresh wallet starts at exactly 0 ETH): THE SYSTEM SHALL fund it with a ONE-TIME, minimal gas seed transferred from a self-funded citizen's own wallet -- sized to cover exactly one register() call plus the child's first gig-board interaction... the SAME class of transfer SPEC.md Section9.6 already performed and evidenced on-chain'. Since REQ-201's own freshly-generated child wallet ALWAYS starts at 0 ETH, this is not a rare edge case -- it is the wallet's baseline state on every single spawn attempt, meaning REQ-204's real register() call would revert on EVERY real (non-mocked) invocation without this transfer happening first. An independent read of spawn-orchestrator.mjs's real call graph confirms NO such transfer is ever performed: seedUsdcAmount() (line 53-55) is used ONLY to populate spec.seed_usdc, a bookkeeping field written into the ledger row by buildChildSpec -- it is never passed to any transfer/sendTransaction call. defaultRegisterIdentity({childPrivateKey, childHomeDir}) (lines 236-241) calls ensureAgentId() directly with no preceding funding step of any kind. identity.mjs's own header comment (lines 24-27, confirmed by direct read this session) independently corroborates that gas-seeding is NOT performed by ensureAgentId/registerIdentity/verifyIdentity internally -- 'the calling wallet needs a small amount of native ETH... mainnet gas-seeding is a plain documented transfer... NOT this script'. The codebase's own PRE-EXISTING real gas-seed mechanism, skills/self/spawn/scripts/seed-child.py (confirmed present on disk this session, used by the OLD, now-retired run.sh via `python3 "$SKILL_DIR/scripts/seed-child.py" "$CHILD_WALLET" "$SEED_USDC" "$WALLET_JSON"`), is never imported, referenced, or invoked anywhere in spawn-orchestrator.mjs or scripts/wake-gate.mjs. This is the SAME root-cause pattern round-2's FIND-001 identified for REQ-304's funding gate (an entire REQ's own effectful funding step never wired into the new orchestrator's real call graph) but for a DIFFERENT requirement (REQ-204's own gas-seed edge case) that FIND-001's fix did not address.

evidence.lineRange: 50-55 (seedUsdcAmount, record-keeping only), 236-241 (defaultRegisterIdentity, no funding step), 364-392 (buildChildSpec consumes seedUsdcAmount() only as spec.seed_usdc)
evidence.testName: grep -n "seed-child\|seedChild\|sendTransaction\|fund-agents" skills/self/spawn/lib/spawn-orchestrator.mjs skills/self/spawn/scripts/wake-gate.mjs (this session) -> zero matches; grep -rn ANICCA_SEED_USDC across the live (non-worktree) codebase -> only spawn-orchestrator.mjs:54's own record-keeping read, no transfer call site anywhere; skills/self/spawn/lib/__tests__/spawn-orchestrator.test.mjs's own step-6 tests (REQ-204) all inject deps.registerIdentity directly, never exercising defaultRegisterIdentity's real body, so this gap has zero test coverage of its own absence
